description: This file defines classes, functions, and utilities for handling dynamic shape annotations, constraints, and shape inference in PyTorch export workflows. It includes classes for shape hints, dimensions, constraints, and functions for processing and refining dynamic shape specifications.

classes.name: _DimHintType
classes.description: Enum for dynamic shape hints: AUTO, STATIC, DYNAMIC.

classes.name: _DimHint
classes.description: Internal class representing shape hints with min/max bounds and factory behavior.

classes.name: Dim
classes.description: Class representing a dimension that can be static, dynamic, or named, with support for relations and bounds.

classes.name: _StaticDim
classes.description: Subclass of Dim for static dimensions with fixed value.

classes.name: _DerivedDim
classes.description: Subclass of Dim for derived dimensions expressed as functions of other dims.

classes.name: _Constraint
classes.description: Represents a dimension constraint with range and serialization.

classes.name: _PhantomRoot
classes.description: Represents a phantom root for derived dims not directly tied to input shapes.

classes.name: _DerivedConstraint
classes.description: Represents a derived dimension constraint with a root and transformation function.

classes.name: _RelaxedConstraint
classes.description: Represents a relaxed (auto) constraint leaving relations for inference.

classes.name: _IntWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper for integers to mark dynamism in shape inference.

classes.name: ShapesCollection
classes.description: Builder class for constructing dynamic shape specifications for inputs.

classes.name: AdditionalInputs
classes.description: Class to infer dynamic shapes from additional test inputs for export validation.
